definition: In this packet, upper threshold refers to the high-end limit of temperature tolerance, near which reef-building corals typically live. It describes the point beyond which heat is expected to cause stress or exceed thermotolerance.

reasons: The packet is about reef corals, thermotolerance, and elevated temperatures; it does not support a mental health sense for the term.
